name: ad-lockout-list
description: R158.50.7l (2026-10-08) supersedes 1.0.5 R158.50.7e cross-domain displayName fix. 1.0.5 used Get-ADUser -Server $TargetDomainName but the actual EventData TargetDomainName is the caller workstation hostname in cross-domain trust, not an AD domain FQDN (verified on KDLFLOFADSRV2 2026-10-08: TargetDomainName='BJ-L-PF27GZN7' == CallerComputerName, not 'SPHKDL' the AD domain). Get-ADUser -Server <workstation> fails 'unable to contact server', displayName returned null. 1.0.6 reverts to the R139.1 default-Get-ADUser idiom (no -Server, queries the current user logon domain = local AD domain on a DC), which works for 99% of 4740 lockouts. Cache key simplified to SAM only; null lookups are NOT cached (R158.50.7e lesson — caching null locked the bad state for 24h). R158.50.7f 0-hit idle recognition preserved. R158.49.1 callerComputerName regex preserved. R158.52 per-event try/catch preserved. R158.50.5 FilterXml preserved. R158.50.6 stdout error field preserved. minVersion stays at 0.1.2.
